methods: Actual 120 Hz TrackRace with condition-dependent axle friction envelopes, braking profiles and power. Three entrants evaluated together as independent ghosts; deterministic, no GA search. Dry, warm baseline, default modeled SOC/ambient. Existing costs/specs unchanged.
limitations: Thermal thresholds, cooling, wear, HEV battery capacity and engine charging policy are gameplay estimates. This matrix validates bounded coherent behavior and scenario differences; it is not measured vehicle calibration, human enjoyment validation, or proof that these three setups are globally optimal. Four variants, two circuits only.
